response_text: {"paragraphs":[{"paragraph_id":"MA-S4:P2","paragraph_markdown":"When the positional-encoding configuration flag is enabled, the model loads the document identity embeddings and adds them to the passage representations, producing the intermediate sum of passages + document_id_embeddings. It then loads the passage identity embeddings and adds them to this intermediate result, yielding the final expression passages + document_id_embeddings + passage_id_embeddings, which replaces the original passages tensor for all downstream contrastive computations. The positive and negative similarity vectors are concatenated into a single similarity tensor of length equal to the sum of the positive and negative counts, forming the contrastive set over which the InfoNCE denominator is evaluated. A guard branch inspects whether the per-sample loss tensor has zero entries; in that case the routine emits diagnostic output for the affected sample. Under normal operation the aggregated loss is returned as the scalar output of the forward pass."}],"section_id":"MA-S4"}
